dez🐰🐟

Hello! Nice to meet you.

I came here to ask for an illustration of my original character "Your Eden is Here".

◆Request
I would like you to draw an illustration for me.
Details of the OC are in the reference materials.

◆Composition
I'll leave it to you!
There are a lot of characters, so it's okay if you just draw the face...!
It's okay if you simplify the clothes, etc.

◆Reference materials
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TC8NE_S_DCXGg37POExfe-lXVQHhRRUZ?usp=drive_link

I know you're busy, so it's okay if you don't ask◎
Thank you for your consideration.
I'll continue to support you!

Dear dez🐰🐟 Nice to meet you!
Please excuse my request message, I was attracted by your nice illustration!

I would like to ask you to consider the following request if it is acceptable.

What I would like to request is my OC who participated in the CoC "Paranormal Crime".
I will put a light setting as follows.

𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄 𓐄

◾︎ Setting
A member of the FBI's Paranormal Crime Analysis Division, a team of profilers in charge of [ paranormal and occult serial killer cases ].

◾︎ Character
HO3 Former Job
Name: Aiden Ward
Age: 26
Height: 177
At best, he is optimistic, friendly, and very confident. At worst, he is lazy, moody, thrill-seeking and hard to get off his chest.

He is skilled at hacking and supporting front line members. He sends gifs to your PC that you don't understand.
He also has a warm side as he counsels children who have been victimized.
He plays the role of an idiot, a joker, and a lightweight. However, he has a strong sense of justice and is afraid of "being worried.

He is afraid of dying and hates pain, but he takes his own life lightly.

▼Contents
I would like to ask for a single picture.
Please check the material for appearance.
Please feel free to draw him bright, a little dark, or serious.

Usage
Icons and headers for SNS, ornamental use.

Others
If money or other items are missing, we would like you to resend them to us.

Thank you for your consideration.
